1.summary: The report page parts are built once and shared by every scenario: the REPORT core, the web v21 page (ReportPage, Daylight keys), the mobile binding and host, the summary, the See-details sheets, the lot-view drawing component, the picture and image selection, the ad slot, What we checked, Add lot size, the admin preview and the Daylight tokens. The two detached cards o1 and o2 bind the size, storeys, footprint and homes fields; every cost, CoA, neighbour, setback, coverage, FSI, height and wall-height part renders ruled pending text because no field is declared or served. The customer producer returns null for every lot until MB-44, so everything renders on goldens and the admin preview only. Not built: the gallery, the side view, summary photos, the units switch, the heart, share, the extra lot rows.
